title: Update show the picker algorithm for WebDriver BiDi file dialog behavior
body: Update the `show the picker, if applicable` algorithm for `` to pass `element's node navigable` to `WebDriver BiDi file dialog opened` and handle the returned `file dialog behavior struct` (`accepted` and `paths`) defined in https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/pull/1193. - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * [Chromium](https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/pull/1193) - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * Companion WPT RFC: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/rfcs/pull/246 * Companion WPT PR: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64840 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * WebDriver BiDi: https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/pull/1193 * Chromium: https://crbug.com/346563686 * Gecko: N/A * WebKit: N/A * Deno (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, module resolution, web workers, and web storage): N/A * Node.js (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, and module resolution): N/A - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A -
